radiator_core.title: 240mm Aluminum Radiator Core
radiator_core.description: High-density dual-pass aluminum heat exchanger featuring 12 flattened water micro-channels intertwined with serpentine cooling fins.

cooling_fans.title: Dual 120mm PWM Radiator Fans
cooling_fans.description: Twin 120mm high-static-pressure cooling fans optimized for pushing laminar airflow through dense radiator fin matrices.

radiator_shroud.title: Radiator Housing & End Tanks
radiator_shroud.description: Formed steel protective outer frame with integrated fluid distribution end tanks and standardized 240mm chassis mounting threads.

epdm_tubing.title: Braided EPDM Coolant Hoses
epdm_tubing.description: Dual flexible low-permeability synthetic EPDM rubber tubes enclosed in dense nylon braiding to eliminate coolant evaporation.

swivel_barbs.title: Rotary 90-Degree Swivel Fittings
swivel_barbs.description: Dual sealed rotary swivel hose barbs allowing 360-degree articulation for kink-free tube routing inside compact PC chassis.

pump_block.title: 3-Phase Motor Pump Block
pump_block.description: High-efficiency ceramic bearing 3-phase motor spinning a closed impeller to circulate liquid coolant across the copper micro-channels.

copper_coldplate.title: Micro-Skived Copper Coldplate
copper_coldplate.description: Oxygen-free copper baseplate machined with sub-0.1mm micro-fins to maximize thermal contact surface area over the CPU core.

mounting_ring.title: Universal Multi-Socket Retention Ring
mounting_ring.description: Stamped steel socket mounting bracket equipped with 4 spring-loaded thumbscrews delivering uniform retention downforce.

top_infinity_cap.title: Infinity Mirror Pump Top Display
top_infinity_cap.description: High-polish tinted dark acrylic top cover with semi-reflective internal mirror optics and subtle accent diffusion ring.

fan_screws.title: Radiator Long Fan Screws
fan_screws.description: Eight black steel 30mm UNC 6-32 pan-head screws securing the dual 120mm fans firmly against the radiator core.

wiring_harness.title: Pump & Fan Wiring Harness
wiring_harness.description: Braided wiring harness providing 3-pin pump tachometer feedback and daisy-chained 4-pin PWM fan speed synchronization.

thermal_paste_layer.title: Pre-Applied Thermal Compound
thermal_paste_layer.description: Factory-applied circular grid pattern of high-conductivity non-curing thermal paste ensuring zero microscopic air gaps.
